question: Of the two alfalfa silage groups, how many silos were in the group with the lower pH, and what acetic acid concentration did that group have?
rendered: Based on the document "Fermentation Quality Divergence of Alfalfa Silage within the Same Batch: Insights from 16S rRNA Sequencing and Untargeted Metabolomics", the group with the lower pH was the LPGood group, which consisted of 49 silos. The acetic acid concentration in the LPGood group was 11.27 g/kg DM.
